page: Google Cloud Platform c3-highmem-44 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 44 vCPUs derived from 22 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, supported by 105 MB of L3 cache. System memory totals 352 GB of RAM, offering an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. The hardware platform integrates advanced instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES and SHA-NI. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs and features no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent disks.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent throughput across standard compute and memory workloads. The processor achieved a multi-core score of 15596.0 on Geekbench and a PassMark CPU score of 47633.9, landing solidly in average benchmark distributions. Memory subsystem testing reflects 112.56 GB/sec read and 49.98 GB/sec write bandwidth on large 256 MB blocks, along with 47.31 million operations per second during Redis SET testing. Extended vector operations and hardware encryption tests show strong performance, registering a PassMark CPU encryption score of 38870.97.

For machine learning inference without specialized GPUs, smaller language models (135M parameters) perform well, yielding 2533.54 prompt tokens per second and 301.08 text generation tokens per second due to AMX and AVX-512 instructions. However, performance degrades substantially on very large models, with 70B parameter text generation falling to 2.41 tokens per second, placing it in the bottom tier for that specific test.

With its generous 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the c3-highmem-44 provides solid qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy enterprise deployments that do not need local disk IOPS. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, large Redis clusters, big data caching layers, enterprise application servers, and CPU-driven small-to-medium model inference tasks.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-highmem-44 is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor delivering 44 dedicated vCPUs (22 physical cores) clocked at 2.7 GHz alongside 352 GB of system RAM. Utilizing an x86_64 architecture equipped with AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets, it features an 8 GB per core memory footprint without bundled local storage or integrated GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show balanced computational and memory bandwidth capabilities, with standout performance in cryptographic encryption and CPU-based lightweight LLM inference. In contrast, very large 70B parameter models show significant generation bottlenecks. The c3-highmem-44 provides strong qualitative density for workloads requiring vast RAM pools relative to compute power, making it well fitted for in-memory caches, large database instances, big data analytics, and high-concurrency enterprise services.
